# Brick Aggregat

> Index of free and open-source software for the TrimUI Brick, Brick Hammer and Brick Pro: firmwares, music apps, emulators, tools, plus a developer knowledge base.

## Data
- [All projects as JSON](https://70b185.github.io/BrickAggregat/export/projects.json): one object per project, with licence, activity, firmwares
- [Catalogue as Markdown](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/tree/main/catalog)

## Developing for the Brick
- [Developing for the TrimUI Brick](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/README.md)
- [Sources](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/SOURCES.md)
- [Sound and MIDI](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/audio-midi.md)
- [Building, deploying, testing](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/building.md)
- [The devices](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/devices.md)
- [Firmwares, as a developer sees them](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/firmwares.md)
- [Open questions](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/open-questions.md)
- [NextUI and MinUI paks](https://github.com/70b185/BrickAggregat/blob/main/knowledge/paks.md)
